draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 168th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 24th of 39 at LB. He lasted until pick 255, well after his grade rank (168th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 62 tackles in 2019, 26th of 39 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 43 career games and 31 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 9 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2023.
